September 25, 2026
NOTICE:
Early Voting in DuPage County is now open!
5 Early Voting locations will be open weekdays and weekends! All information can be found here!

Early Voting Locations Across DuPage County

  • The Early Voting program allows any eligible DuPage County voter to vote before Election Day.
  • All locations are 100% compliant with the Americans with Disabilities Act.

Find the Early Voting Location nearest you!

  • Find an Early Voting Location near you (GIS application) for November 3, 2026, General Election

Temporary Early Voting Locations in DuPage County

  • Are available 40 days prior to an election.
    • Starting Thursday, September 24, 2026, for November 3, 2026, General Election.
  • Weekdays:  8:00 a.m. – 4:30 p.m.
  • Saturdays:  9:00 a.m. – 12:00 p.m.
  • Locations become Permanent Early Voting Locations starting Monday, October 19, 2026.

Permanent Early Voting Locations in DuPage County

  • Are available 15 days prior to an election.
    • Starting Monday, October 19, 2026, for November 3, 2026, General Election.
  • Are open Monday through Sunday.
  • Weekdays:  8:00 a.m. – 7:00 p.m.
  • Weekends:  9:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m.

Early Voting Process

Election workers verify the voter's registration status through the KNOWiNK Poll Pad. If registered, the voter is validated and receives a Paper Ballot to vote on. Once the voter has completed voting their Ballot, the voter inserts their Ballot into the Verity Scan unit. If the voter is not registered, they must register to receive a Ballot.

  • Upon validation, the database is updated preventing the voter from voting again in the Election.
  • Early Voting Ballots are tabulated after the Polls close on Election Day.
